rationale: The original breakout thesis has weakened: after testing $113.80, the last several 1-minute candles show lower highs and lower lows, and price has fallen to 87.6% of today’s range while giving back more than half of the maximum favorable move. With the spread still wide and short-term momentum stalling, closing locks in the remaining unrealized gain instead of risking a reversal toward the distant invalidation level.
